## Details

<a id="set_sprite_position"></a>
### [`set_sprite_position`](../../../../src/screen/sprite_position.asm#L6) `$845C`

*routine*

Sets the position of sprite Y: x = $07 * 2, y = $08. Bit 8 of x goes into $d010. Keeps X. Changes A and Y.

- **Called from:** [`$842B`](../../../../src/title/title_mower.asm#L47), [`$8438`](../../../../src/title/title_mower.asm#L54), [`$8556`](../../../../src/title/title_walk.asm#L40), [`$857B`](../../../../src/title/title_walk.asm#L58), [`$85B3`](../../../../src/title/title_walk.asm#L87), [`$85DE`](../../../../src/title/title_walk.asm#L109), [`$861E`](../../../../src/title/title_walk.asm#L141), [`$862B`](../../../../src/title/title_walk.asm#L148), [`borrow_mower_scene`](../game/borrow_mower_scene.md#borrow_mower_scene), [`place_mower_and_gordon`](../player/place_mower.md#place_mower_and_gordon), [`move_actor`](../actors/actor_move.md#move_actor), [`$97EE`](../../../../src/neighbour/neighbour_catch.asm#L43) and 1 more
